title: SpaceX wins approval for up to one million orbital computing satellites. Anthropic’s CEO argues for democratic control of AI
description: The FCC set a ceiling for SpaceX’s planned network of data centers in orbit. Dario Amodei explained who he thinks should govern AI. In bankruptcy court, 42 attorneys general challenged a sale that would put private Character.AI chats in a buyer’s hands. OpenAI also began testing a shared usage allowance for Chat and Work.

spacex-orbital-compute.verification_scope: The FCC announcement and the chairman’s public statement describe the authorized constellation size and communications links.

amodei-democratic-control.verification_scope: Amodei’s public statement sets out his argument about democratic legitimacy, efficiency and governing authority. The accompanying report provides context.

character-chat-sale-objection.verification_scope: The California attorney general’s announcement and the coalition’s November 20 objection describe the proposed sale, account totals and privacy concerns. The objection records the states’ position.

chat-work-quota.verification_scope: Sottiaux’s post identifies the limited test group. OpenAI’s comments to TechCrunch distinguish the shared allowance from Instant usage.

ny-chatbot-toys.verification_scope: The governor’s announcement gives the five-year term and effective date. The next day’s reporting examines implementation.

scientists-agent-evidence.verification_scope: The institute’s interview report discusses literature selection, how researchers can verify the work and how scientists could help design evaluations.

health-risk-reliance.verification_scope: Version 1, sections 3.1 and 4.1 and Tables 2 and 3 report the sample, conditions, trust ratings and confidence in judging when to rely on the model.
health-risk-reliance.date_note: Version 1 submitted November 24 and listed by arXiv on November 25

cambridge-learning-assessment.verification_scope: The publisher’s episode description and the chapters at 10:29 and 17:30 were checked against the Concourse listing.
cambridge-learning-assessment.date_note: Interview published November 23 and featured November 26

llamacpp-async-host-input.verification_scope: Release b12732 and merged pull request #30685 describe input copying, backend support and synchronization. No performance benchmark was run.
